absence_meaning: None means no tested SNR was worse; no interpolation/extrapolation
blur_protocol: Lab8 blur level1 sigma=.5, kernel5 on raw224face tensor before same frozen encoder
threshold_interpretation: Highest discrete tested SNR with lower F1 than missing audio, not an interpolated/monotone threshold. Dropout curve is nonmonotone; the30dB difference is small and one-seed descriptive.
